title: How to Build a Scheduling App Without Code (Replace Calendly in an Afternoon)
summary: Build a custom scheduling app with database, auth, and payments included. Skip Calendly's $100/month fees. Start free on Blink.
body_markdown: Calendly and Acuity are SaaS tools you subscribe to. You don't own them, can't modify them, and pay forever. With Blink, you build an app you own — the code, the database, the hosting. You can add any feature, connect any service, and change any behavior. You're not paying per seat or waiting for a product roadmap to catch up.
